svg.title: Full hub schematic with SS8050 transistors
svg.desc: XIAO ESP32-C3 drives a hub IR channel (D10, SS8050 Q1, three strings of two IR LEDs with 22 ohm each) and a blaster channel (D7, SS8050 Q2, jack with two LEDs, 22 ohm). Each base has 220 ohm in series and 10k to ground. C1 470 microfarad and C2 100 nanofarad on 5V. An AMS1117 module makes 3.3V for an nRF24L01 on D1 to D5, with C3 10 microfarad and C4 100 nanofarad at the radio.
